headline: Top 5 watch releases this week
stop_reason: Not enough verified releases. Checked brand press pages: Omega (404), Tudor (403), Breitling newsroom (blog listing only, no dated releases). Rolex press page not readable in earlier attempts. Searches returned only blogs, roundups and grey-market listings, which cannot supply items under the TOP 5 rules. Fewer than five official releases with dated US prices were found, so no carousel was made. Fallback NEW RELEASES also needs one official dated release, none found. Suggest a different format or a later run when brand press pages post new releases.
